base_url.label: Router URL
base_url.description: Address of the llama.cpp router (llama serve), without a trailing path

api_key_file.label: API key file
api_key_file.description: File holding the router's API key (blank: ~/.local/state/llama-serve/api-key, managed by llama-key)

max_rate.label: Full meter at (t/s)
max_rate.description: Token rate that fills the meter

hold_seconds.label: Hold last rate (s)
hold_seconds.description: How long the last request's rate stays up before the lifetime average returns

show_value.label: Show value
show_value.description: Print the token rate next to the meter
